en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Noman, from Yahys Al Azraq who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who was murdered and left debts, and there was not wealth for him. So his guardians took the wergild. Is it upon them to pay off his debts?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘And if he had not left anything?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. But rather, they took the wergild, therefore it is upon them that they pay off his debts’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Nu’man from Yahya al-Arzaq who has narrated the following: “

I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who is killed, leaving behind a debt and has left no assets but his heirs receive the wergild; if they must pay his debt. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, they must do so.’ I then asked, ‘Even if he does not leave anything they must pay his debts?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, because they have received the wergild, thus, they must pay his debt.’”
